children.name: Toledonia bullata
children.description: Toledonia bullata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ringiculidae.

children.name: Toledonia limnaeoides
children.description: Male reproductive system (Fig. 8 D): Short unbranched prostate emerging from short tubular penial sheath. Ecology. Found between 10 – 804 m and in haddock stomachs (Warén 1989; Høisaeter 2009) on stones, stones with hydroids and algae (Odhner 1913). Høisaeter (2009) found the species in negative temperatures on the Norwegian continental slope.

children.name: Toledonia perplexa Dall, 1902
children.description: Shell height to 2.5 mm (up to 4.1 mm according to Dall 1902); elongate-ovate, delicate. Protoconch of 1.5 slightly convex whorls. Teleoconch of up to 2 whorls, slightly convex in outline; last whorl comprising about 85 % of total shell height. Suture deep, slightly channeled. Surface white; only sculptured with faint growth lines. Aperture ovate, interior white; columella with a strong fold, callus narrow, slightly expanded over the umbilical area.

children.name: Cylichna cylindracea
children.description: Cylichna cylindracea is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Cylichnidae.

children.name: Cylichna gouldii
children.description:
Cylichna gouldii is a species of very small sea snail, a small bubble snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cylichnidae.
This bubble snail lives in the Western Atlantic Ocean and has been found in Nova Scotia, Maine and Massachusetts.

children.name: Sphaerocylichna incommoda
children.description: Sphaerocylichna incommoda is a species of deepsea snail or bubble snail, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Cylichnidae, the canoe bubbles or chalice bubble snails.
